scientific_finding: When trained strictly on Friday volumetric attacks (DDoS LOIC and PortScan), neither Model A nor Model B can detect Tuesday authentication brute force zero-shot (Recall ~21% for Model A, ~23% for Model B) because Friday training traffic contained ZERO samples of port 21 (FTP) or port 22 (SSH) attacks. A model cannot leverage destination port indicators for brute-force vectors without multi-vector training data.
